card.name: Subject words before a verb like receive
card.fires_on: The subject of a clause about people or patients (person, individuals who, patients, women who) or a helper word right after it (can, may, to, also), at the point where a verb such as get, catch, be given or be denied is expected.

modes.label: Person subject
modes.description: A noun or pronoun naming people or patients, often followed by who, where the next word is a verb of receiving or contracting.
modes.example: What it means to the<< person>> who hears it.

modes.label: Helper word before the verb
modes.description: A small word such as can, may, to or also that comes right before a verb like catch, be admitted or be denied.
modes.example: humans<< can>> catch Brucellosis from animals

card.writes: It suppresses forms of receive, so it pushes the model away from predicting that verb next.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a people-subject where the next word would be a verb like get or catch, and steers away from the word receive.
